  • [v3.0.0] Ignoring ApplicationSet `applyNestedSelectors` field: Setting the `spec.applyNestedSelectors` field in an ApplicationSet resolves counter-intuitive behavior…  (migration · declared · ev-e24f6e836412)
  • [v3.0.0] Logs RBAC enforcement as a first-class RBAC citizen: 2.4 introduced `logs` as a new RBAC resource  (migration · declared · ev-19231a7aa629)
  • [v3.0.0] Use Annotation-Based Tracking by Default: The default behavior for tracking resources has changed to use annotation-based tracking instead of label-based…  (migration · declared · ev-07e8b4d1d6f1)
